actions.desc: _Ranged Weapon Attack:_ +7 to hit, range 60/240 ft., one target. _Hit:_ 19 (3d10+3) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) fire damage.
actions.desc_ru: Атака оружием дальнего боя: +7 к попаданию, дистанция 60/240 фт., одна цель. Попадание: 19 (3к10+3) дробящего урона плюс 13 (3к8) огненного урона.
actions.name: Lava Boulder

actions.desc: The fire giant makes two Flaming Greatsword or Lava Boulder attacks.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.desc: A burst of volcanic gas and rock fragments flows in a 60-foot-line that is 5 feet wide from the fire giant's outstretched hand. Each creature in the line must succeed on a DC 16 DEX save or be poisoned until the end of its next turn and pushed up to 15 feet away from the giant. A creature that fails the save by 5 or more is petrified in volcanic ash for 1 hour or until a creature spends 1 minute soaking the petrified creature in cool water.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Пйрокластик Сурге»; тип: bonus_action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Pyroclastic Surge

actions.desc: The fire giant expels built-up heat from within itself, sending a blast of lava outward. Each creature within 15 feet of the fire giant must make a DC 16 DEX save. On a failure, a creature takes 36 (8d8) fire damage and is knocked prone. On a success, a creature takes half the damage and isn't knocked prone. A creature that fails this save has disadvantage on the next save it makes against the giant's Pyroclastic Surge before the start of the giant's next turn.
actions.desc_ru: Действие «Волканик Бурст»; тип: action. Производный машинный текст из структурированных полей записи; полный исходный текст — в поле desc (требуется перевод и редакторская вычитка).
actions.name: Volcanic Burst

traits.desc: The fire giant is resistant to the stunned condition, and it is vulnerable to the prone condition.
